name: Focus Context
description: Before a piece of work starts, picks the notes the person already saved about their named focus that bear on the request, and writes the brief the harness is given and the one line the person reads.
purpose: Start a session from what the person already knows about their own focus, so "my practice" is answered from it first and files are searched only for the rest.
approach: Read the sources the person configured (a folder of saved cards, a folder of text files, a program's output or a consumer's provider function) into notes, rank the notes at home in the named focus first through the Context Retriever's focus_first arm (soft affinity, ranking only, the scope fence kept), always offer the focus's short overview, add the few best notes to the brief with the rule to use them before searching, and name them in one line on screen.
out_of_scope: Ranking pieces of text for an answer within a token budget (Context Retriever does that), building cards from files (Cards From Files), choosing the files of a working folder to show (Folder View), what a consumer's data model calls a focus (the consumer maps it onto the focus tag).
milestones: 1. The selected arm puts the needed notes in the brief on the invented cases with no note outside the scope shown, above the arm that searches by the request's words (metric-focus-context). 2. A real fast-tier run of the terminal answers from the focus's notes (recorded as a finding of the metric).
measures_of_success: The needed notes of the person's focus are in the brief, little else is, nothing outside the scope is, and the person sees one line saying which notes were used.
parameters: The request, the notes (id, title, text, affinity_tags, scope_tags, overview, timestamp), the focus, a note limit, a token budget and the scope tags the request may read.
inputs: A request, notes read from the person's sources, a focus and a scope.
outputs: A FocusContext: the notes to show best first, the brief text for the harness and the one on-screen line ("Using 4 saved notes about <focus>").
effects: Reads the sources the person configured (a folder, a program the person named, a consumer's provider function) when the terminal gathers; the arms themselves read nothing and write nothing.
usage_notes: `ahohs work` reads the person's context file (`--context FILE`, `AHOHS_CONTEXT`, else `~/.config/ahohs/context.toml`; no file, no change) and wraps its harness so every run starts from the notes of the focus. The file's keys are documented in `hubofhubs/the_intelligence/subconscious/focus_context/settings.py`. A consumer passes `context_provider` (a function from a focus to notes) to the work command.
